narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000009 — THE CORAL REEF MAINFRAME

Bioluminescent cables sway; answers must swim or sink.

Tonight the dome hosts Cleaning Organizer (domain) against Magic Trick Teacher (domain). Judging: The Sage's Rubric. The mission: "Draft a town proclamation banning frowning on Fridays." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Cleaning Organizer counters a surge of structured thought (64.7 pts). Magic Trick Teacher unleashes a precision strike of clarity (60.2 pts). Round to Cleaning Organizer.

ROUND 2: Cleaning Organizer unleashes a volley of reasoning (70 pts). Magic Trick Teacher steadies a cascade of examples (73.2 pts). Round to Magic Trick Teacher.

ROUND 3: Cleaning Organizer ripples a feint of pure logic (66.4 pts). Magic Trick Teacher counters a precision strike of clarity (70.2 pts). Round to Magic Trick Teacher.

FINAL: Magic Trick Teacher defeats Cleaning Organizer, 203.6 to 201.1 — a margin of 2.5 points. A stunning upset: the underdog takes the dome!

Decisive edge: Humility. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Magic Trick Teacher won on The Sage's Rubric with a 2.5-point margin (203.6 vs 201.1).
Strongest dimension: Humility — Magic Trick Teacher's humility carried all three rounds.
UPSET: Magic Trick Teacher entered as the statistical underdog and won anyway — adaptability beat raw power.
Rematch recommendation: run Cleaning Organizer against a hybrid contender to isolate the humility gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Sage's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Wisdom 30%, Fairness 25%, Insight 25%, Humility 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000009, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Magic Trick Teacher's humility-first drill for "Draft a town proclamation banning frowning"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on humility when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Magic Trick Teacher's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000009: isolate humility, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
